instruction: From the FlightAware homepage, navigate to the community discussions and open the 'FlightAware Discussions' main page.

metadata.explanation: Variation requires navigating to the main discussions landing page. Uses exact URL matching like the original task. Simpler navigation than original (main page vs specific thread).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_tab_info extracts active tab URL and page info properly
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_active_tab compares URLs using compare_urls utility with proper URL normalization
Expected value is semantically correct: https://discussions.flightaware.com/ matches the instruction requirement to open FlightAware Discussions main page
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator verifies the final state (active tab URL) which confirms both navigation to community discussions and opening the main discussions page
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict with 'url' key, metric extracts URL and compares against expected value
goto_prefix parameter is properly used through internal call to get_active_url_from_accessTree
